hindi: विजिगीषु इस प्रकार दूसरी प्रकृति को सहारा दे।
english: The conqueror should support the second constituent element in this way.
notes: The text does not say which prakṛti is 'the second'; not guessed. 'evam' is rendered 'in this way'; what it points to is not stated here. upagṛhṇīyāt rendered 'support' (cf. glossary 11.1 upagṛhya).
lines_deva: विजिगीषुर् द्वितीयां प्रकृतिम् एवम् उपगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: vijigīṣur dvitīyāṃ prakṛtim evam upagṛhṇīyāt

words.gloss: in forts, forests and places of retreat
having got a share of the gain

hindi: सामन्त पर सामन्त के साथ मिलकर चढ़ाई करे, या यदि सोचे “मेरी पार्ष्णि नहीं पकड़ेगा, पार्ष्णिग्राह को रोकेगा, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, उसके पास नहीं जाएगा, मेरे लिए सेना की द्विगुणता होगी, मेरे लिए रसद और सहायक सेना को प्रवृत्त करेगा, दूसरे का निवारण करेगा, बहुत बाधाओं वाले मेरे मार्ग में काँटों को कुचलेगा, दुर्ग, वन, अपसारों में सेना के साथ विचरण करेगा, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, उसे असह्य दोष में या सन्धि में रखेगा, या लाभ का अंश पाया हुआ दूसरे शत्रुओं को मेरे प्रति विश्वास कराएगा”।
english: [He] should march against a neighbouring chief, joining with a neighbouring chief, or if [he] should think: “[He] will not seize my heel; [he] will restrain the heel-seizer; [he] will not go up to the one to be marched against; there will be a doubling of the army for me; [he] will set in motion for me the supplies and reinforcements; [he] will restrain [those] of the other; [he] will crush the thorns on my path with its many hindrances; [he] will move about with the army in forts, forests and places of retreat; [he] will place the one to be marched against in an unbearable defect or in a treaty; or, having got a share of the gain, [he] will make other enemies trust me.”
notes: Subject of 'yāyāt' and of the quoted verbs is not stated ('[he]' in English only). First 'sāmantam' is read as object of yāyāt (march against) and 'sāmantena' as the partner; the sense 'taking a neighbouring chief along with a neighbouring chief' is also possible. pārṣṇi: 'heel' as in glossary 12.3 (pārṣṇiṃ grah). 'yātavyaṃ na-abhisariṣyati': abhi-√sṛ rendered literally 'go up to'; 'advance against' is possible. 'parasya vārayiṣyati': object missing (probably the supplies/reinforcements of the other); left elliptical. vīvadha = supplies, āsāra = reinforcements here (as 10.4). doṣa rendered 'defect' (glossary 3.15); 'fault' or 'difficulty' possible. daṇḍa = army; apasāra = place of retreat (10.2). The quotation closes with iti.
lines_deva: सामन्तं सामन्तेन सम्भूय यायात्, यदि वा मन्येत "पार्ष्णिं मे न ग्रहीष्यति, पार्ष्णि.ग्राहं वारयिष्यति, यातव्यं न-अभिसरिष्यति, बल.द्वैगुण्यं मे भविष्यति, वीवध.आसारौ मे प्रवर्तयिष्यति, परस्य वारयिष्यति, बह्व्.आबाधे मे पथि कण्टकान् मर्दयिष्यति, दुर्ग.अटव्य्.अपसारेषु दण्डेन चरिष्यति, यातव्यम् अविषह्ये दोषे सन्धौ वा स्थापयिष्यति, लब्ध.लाभ.अंशो वा शत्रून् अन्यान् मे विश्वासयिष्यति" इति
lines_iast: sāmantaṃ sāmantena sambhūya yāyāt, yadi vā manyeta "pārṣṇiṃ me na grahīṣyati, pārṣṇi.grāhaṃ vārayiṣyati, yātavyaṃ na-abhisariṣyati, bala.dvaiguṇyaṃ me bhaviṣyati, vīvadha.āsārau me pravartayiṣyati, parasya vārayiṣyati, bahv.ābādhe me pathi kaṇṭakān mardayiṣyati, durga.aṭavy.apasāreṣu daṇḍena cariṣyati, yātavyam aviṣahye doṣe sandhau vā sthāpayiṣyati, labdha.lābha.aṃśo vā śatrūn anyān me viśvāsayiṣyati" iti

hindi: या द्वैधीभूत, कोश के द्वारा सेना को, सेना के द्वारा कोश को, सामन्तों में से किसी एक से पाने की इच्छा करे।
english: Or [he] who has become dual should seek to obtain army by means of treasury, treasury by means of army, from any one of the neighbouring chiefs.
notes: dvaidhī-bhūta is rendered 'who has become dual' (glossary 7.2); a link to dvaidhī-bhāva (the dual policy) is possible but not stated. Subject not stated. 'anyatamāl' is regular sandhi for anyatamāt.
lines_deva: द्वैधी.भूतो वा कोशेन दण्डं दण्डेन कोशं सामन्तानाम् अन्यतमाल् लिप्सेत
lines_iast: dvaidhī.bhūto vā kośena daṇḍaṃ daṇḍena kośaṃ sāmantānām anyatamāl lipseta

hindi: उनमें श्रेष्ठ से अधिक अंश के द्वारा, समान से समान के द्वारा, हीन से हीन के द्वारा — यह सम-सन्धि है।
english: Among them: from the superior with a greater share, from the equal with an equal [share], from the inferior with an inferior [share] — such is the equal treaty.
notes: Elliptical: 'share' is carried to samena and hīnena (bracketed in English only). jyāyasaḥ read as ablative parallel to samāt/hīnāt; a genitive reading is possible. The closing iti belongs to the section label (glossary: 'Such is X'; iti glossed 'closing particle'). sama-sandhi = equal treaty (literal). The e-text writes the sandhi d+dh as 'dd h' (hīnādd hīnena); w reads hīnāt; not flagged (glossary 7.7).
lines_deva: तेषां ज्यायसो ऽधिकेन-अंशेन समात् समेन हीनाद्द् हीनेन-इति सम.सन्धिः
lines_iast: teṣāṃ jyāyaso 'dhikena-aṃśena samāt samena hīnādd hīnena-iti sama.sandhiḥ

hindi: विपर्यय में विषम-सन्धि।
english: In reversal, [there is] the unequal treaty.
notes: Verbless; copula bracketed in English only.
lines_deva: विपर्यये विषम.सन्धिः
lines_iast: viparyaye viṣama.sandhiḥ

hindi: उन दोनों में विशेष लाभ से अतिसन्धि।
english: Of the two, from a special gain, [there is] atisandhi (the treaty of outwitting).
notes: 'tayoḥ' = of the two kinds just named (sama and viṣama). atisandhi kept as a term; literal 'treaty of outwitting' (cf. atisandhā = outwit). Copula bracketed in English only.
lines_deva: तयोर् विशेष.लाभाद् अतिसन्धिः
lines_iast: tayor viśeṣa.lābhād atisandhiḥ

hindi: हीन, व्यसन वाले, विनाश के स्थान में लगे हुए या अर्थ न चाहने वाले श्रेष्ठ से सेना के बराबर लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: The inferior should strike a bargain with a superior [one] who is afflicted, engaged in a place of ruin, or not seeking gain, with a gain equal to the army.
notes: vyasanin: 'afflicted' (glossary 3.11); 'given to vice' is possible. apāya-sthāna 'place of ruin' is literal and uncertain (sthāna may mean position/occasion). anarthin: 'not seeking gain' (an-arthin); alternatives 'without purpose' or 'suffering loss'. bala = army (glossary 8.5); 'strength' possible. paṇ = strike a bargain.
lines_deva: व्यसनिनम् अपाय.स्थाने सक्तम् अनर्थिनं वा ज्यायांसं हीनो बल.समेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: vyasaninam apāya.sthāne saktam anarthinaṃ vā jyāyāṃsaṃ hīno bala.samena lābhena paṇeta

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.
lines_deva: पणितस् तस्य-अपकार.समर्थो विक्रमेत, अन्यथा सन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: paṇitas tasya-apakāra.samartho vikrameta, anyathā sandadhyāt

words.gloss: for filling up the deficient power and splendour
one advancing on a probable gain
for protecting the base and rear

hindi: या ऐसा हुआ, हीन शक्ति और प्रताप की पूर्ति के लिए, सम्भावित अर्थ की ओर बढ़ने वाला, या मूल और पिछले भाग की रक्षा के लिए, हीन श्रेष्ठ से सेना के बराबर से विशिष्ट लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or, being of such kind — for filling up [his] deficient power and splendour, one advancing on a probable gain, or for protecting [his] base and rear — the inferior should strike a bargain with a superior with a gain better than [one] equal to the army.
notes: hīna-śakti-pratāpa-pūraṇa could also be read 'filling up the power and splendour of the inferior'. pratāpa rendered 'splendour' (glossary 7.4; literally 'heat, glory'); 'might' (prabhāva, 9.1) is not used. sambhāvya-artha = 'probable/expected gain'; abhisārin = 'advancing on' (literal; 'attacker' possible). pārṣṇi in mūla-pārṣṇi = rear (glossary 12.1). 'bala-samād viśiṣṭena lābhena' = a gain better than the one equal to the army (understood). 'evaṃ-bhūta' refers back to the situation of the preceding units.
lines_deva: एवं.भूतो वा हीन.शक्ति.प्रताप.पूरण.अर्थं सम्भाव्य.अर्थ.अभिसारी मूल.पार्ष्णि.त्राण.अर्थं वा ज्यायांसं हीनो बल.समाद् विशिष्टेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: evaṃ.bhūto vā hīna.śakti.pratāpa.pūraṇa.arthaṃ sambhāvya.artha.abhisārī mūla.pārṣṇi.trāṇa.arthaṃ vā jyāyāṃsaṃ hīno bala.samād viśiṣṭena lābhena paṇeta

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले पर अनुग्रह करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: The one bargained with should favour one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: kalyāṇa-buddhi = of good intent (glossary 9.3); the person is not named. anugṛhṇīyāt = 'should favour' (literally 'take hold with favour').
lines_deva: पणितः कल्याण.बुद्धिम् अनुगृह्णीयात्, अन्यथा विक्रमेत
lines_iast: paṇitaḥ kalyāṇa.buddhim anugṛhṇīyāt, anyathā vikrameta

words.gloss: in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point
for whom loss has set in

hindi: हीन, व्यसन उत्पन्न हुए, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाले, या उपस्थित अनर्थ वाले श्रेष्ठ से, या दुर्ग और मित्र से सहारा पाया हुआ, छोटे मार्ग से शत्रु पर जाने की इच्छा वाला, या बिना युद्ध के अथवा एक-अन्त सिद्धि वाले लाभ को लेने की इच्छा वाला, सेना के बराबर से हीन लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: The inferior, with a superior in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point, or for whom loss has set in — or [the inferior] being supported by fort and ally, desiring to march a short road against the enemy, or desiring to take a gain without battle or of success at one end — should strike a bargain with a gain lower than [one] equal to the army.
notes: The first compound is read 'jāta-vyasana' + 'prakṛti-randhra' (calamity has arisen; weak point in the constituent elements); a different division is possible. The sentence has two alternatives (vā): the superior is in calamity/loss, or the inferior is supported by fort and ally; the exact syntax is not certain. 'śatrum' taken with yātu-kāmaḥ (march against). eka-anta-siddhi = 'success at one end', kept literal (ekānta may mean 'certain' or 'one-sided'). pratiṣṭabdha: 'supported' (prati-stabdha; 'obstructed' is possible). anartha = loss (glossary 9.7). The e-text writes the sandhi d+dh as 'dd h' (bala.samādd hīnena); w reads bala-samāt; not flagged (glossary 7.7).
lines_deva: जात.व्यसन.प्रकृति.रन्ध्रम् उपस्थित.अनर्थं वा ज्यायांसं हीनो दुर्ग.मित्र.प्रतिष्टब्धो वा ह्रस्वम् अध्वानं यातु.कामः शत्रुम् अयुद्धम् एक.अन्त.सिद्धिं वा लाभम् आदातु.कामो बल.समाद्द् हीनेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: jāta.vyasana.prakṛti.randhram upasthita.anarthaṃ vā jyāyāṃsaṃ hīno durga.mitra.pratiṣṭabdho vā hrasvam adhvānaṃ yātu.kāmaḥ śatrum ayuddham eka.anta.siddhiṃ vā lābham ādātu.kāmo bala.samādd hīnena lābhena paṇeta

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.
lines_deva: पणितस् तस्य-अपकार.समर्थो विक्रमेत, अन्यथा सन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: paṇitas tasya-apakāra.samartho vikrameta, anyathā sandadhyāt

words.gloss: free of weak point and calamity
one whose action is badly begun

hindi: या श्रेष्ठ, रन्ध्र और व्यसन से रहित, बुरी तरह आरम्भ किए कर्म वाले को अधिक क्षय और व्यय से जोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, दूष्य सेना को प्रवास में भेजने की इच्छा वाला, या दूष्य सेना को बुलाने की इच्छा वाला, पीड़न के योग्य अथवा उच्छेदन के योग्य को हीन के द्वारा व्यथित करने की इच्छा वाला, या सन्धि-प्रधान, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाला, हीन लाभ को स्वीकार कर ले।
english: Or a superior free of weak point and calamity, desiring to connect one whose action is badly begun with further loss and expenditure, desiring to send away the treasonable army, or desiring to bring in the treasonable army, desiring to distress, by means of the inferior, [one] to be afflicted or to be uprooted, or with treaty foremost, [being] of good intent, should accept a lesser gain.
notes: a-randhra-vyasana read 'free of both weak point and calamity'; 'whose weak point is not a calamity' is possible. yoktu-kāma: yuj with instrumental, rendered literally 'connect' (sense 'burden'). pravāsayitu 'send away' (caus. of pra-√vas, glossary 4.13 for non-persons); āvāhayitu 'bring in'. dūṣya-daṇḍa read 'treasonable army'; 'army of the treasonable' possible. The subject of pratigṛhṇīyāt is the superior (jyāyān). daṇḍa = army (glossary 8.5). The long list of descriptions is a single subject group; the exact grouping of the vā-alternatives is uncertain. Glossary 11.1/12.3 reads pravāsayet of a person as 'do away with'; here the object is an army (dūṣya-daṇḍa), so 'send away' is kept literal; a person should decide.
lines_deva: अरन्ध्र.व्यसनो वा ज्यायान् दुर्.आरब्ध.कर्माणं भूयः क्षय.व्ययाभ्यां योक्तु.कामो दूष्य.दण्डं प्रवासयितु.कामो दूष्य.दण्डम् आवाहयितु.कामो वा पीडनीयम् उच्छेदनीयं वा हीनेन व्यथयितु.कामः सन्धि.प्रधानो वा कल्याण.बुद्धिर् हीनं लाभं प्रतिगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: arandhra.vyasano vā jyāyān dur.ārabdha.karmāṇaṃ bhūyaḥ kṣaya.vyayābhyāṃ yoktu.kāmo dūṣya.daṇḍaṃ pravāsayitu.kāmo dūṣya.daṇḍam āvāhayitu.kāmo vā pīḍanīyam ucchedanīyaṃ vā hīnena vyathayitu.kāmaḥ sandhi.pradhāno vā kalyāṇa.buddhir hīnaṃ lābhaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt

hindi: कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले के साथ मिलकर अर्थ पाने की इच्छा करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: [He] should seek to obtain gain, joining with one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: Subject not stated. 'sambhūya-artham': the e-text joins the two words with '-'; read as two words (having joined; gain). artha = gain.
lines_deva: कल्याण.बुद्धिना सम्भूय-अर्थं लिप्सेत, अन्यथा विक्रमेत
lines_iast: kalyāṇa.buddhinā sambhūya-arthaṃ lipseta, anyathā vikrameta

hindi: इस प्रकार समान समान को छल ले या अनुग्रह करे।
english: In this way an equal should outwit an equal, or favour [him].
notes: Object of anugṛhṇīyāt not repeated; '[him]' bracketed in English only.
lines_deva: एवं समः समम् अतिसन्दध्याद् अनुगृह्णीयाद् वा
lines_iast: evaṃ samaḥ samam atisandadhyād anugṛhṇīyād vā

words.gloss: for protecting the base and rear

hindi: समान, सेना के बराबर लाभ के द्वारा, दूसरे के सेना-दल के प्रति-सेना-दल को, या मित्रों और वन-जातियों के, शत्रु की विभूमियों के मार्गदर्शक को, या मूल और पिछले भाग की रक्षा के लिए सौदा करे।
english: An equal should strike a bargain, with a gain equal to the army, [for] a counter-division to the other's division or [to that] of allies and forest tribes, [for] a guide to the enemy's bad grounds, or for the protection of the base and rear.
notes: Accusatives (pratyanīkam, deśikam) are taken as what is bargained for; '[for]' is bracketed in English. 'mitra-aṭavīnām' parallel to 'para-anīkasya' (genitive); aṭavī here = forest tribes (force sense). vibhūmi 'bad ground' is literal (cf. abhūmi 10.2); sense uncertain. pārṣṇi = rear (12.1).
lines_deva: पर.अनीकस्य प्रत्यनीकं मित्र.अटवीनां वा, शत्रोर् विभूमीनां देशिकं मूल.पार्ष्णि.त्राण.अर्थं वा समो बल.समेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: para.anīkasya pratyanīkaṃ mitra.aṭavīnāṃ vā, śatror vibhūmīnāṃ deśikaṃ mūla.pārṣṇi.trāṇa.arthaṃ vā samo bala.samena lābhena paṇeta

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले पर अनुग्रह करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: The one bargained with should favour one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: kalyāṇa-buddhi = of good intent (glossary 9.3); the person is not named. anugṛhṇīyāt = 'should favour' (literally 'take hold with favour').
lines_deva: पणितः कल्याण.बुद्धिम् अनुगृह्णीयात्, अन्यथा विक्रमेत
lines_iast: paṇitaḥ kalyāṇa.buddhim anugṛhṇīyāt, anyathā vikrameta

words.gloss: [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √labh; m. nom. sg.

hindi: व्यसन उत्पन्न हुए, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाले, अनेक से विरुद्ध के साथ, या दूसरी ओर से पाता हुआ समान, सेना के बराबर से हीन लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: [With one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point, [and who is] opposed by many, or [when] obtaining [it] from elsewhere, an equal should strike a bargain with a gain lower than [one] equal to the army.
notes: The object of paṇeta (the party bargained with) is not named; '[With one]' is bracketed. labhamāna has no object stated ('[it]' bracketed). aneka-viruddha = 'opposed by many' (literal). The e-text writes the sandhi d+dh as 'dd h' (bala.samādd hīnena); w reads bala-samāt; not flagged (glossary 7.7).
lines_deva: जात.व्यसन.प्रकृति.रन्ध्रम् अनेक.विरुद्धम् अन्यतो लभमानो वा समो बल.समाद्द् हीनेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: jāta.vyasana.prakṛti.randhram aneka.viruddham anyato labhamāno vā samo bala.samādd hīnena lābhena paṇeta

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.
lines_deva: पणितस् तस्य-अपकार.समर्थो विक्रमेत, अन्यथा सन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: paṇitas tasya-apakāra.samartho vikrameta, anyathā sandadhyāt

words.gloss: whose business depends on a neighbouring chief
whose army is to be made

hindi: या ऐसा हुआ समान, सामन्त के अधीन कार्य वाला, या बनाई जाने योग्य सेना वाला, सेना के बराबर से विशिष्ट लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or, being of such kind, an equal whose business depends on a neighbouring chief, or whose army is to be made, should strike a bargain with a gain better than [one] equal to the army.
notes: kartavya-bala 'whose army is to be made' is literal; the sense (an army not yet raised) is not stated. The party bargained with is not named.
lines_deva: एवं.भूतो वा समः सामन्त.आयत्त.कार्यः कर्तव्य.बलो वा बल.समाद् विशिष्टेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: evaṃ.bhūto vā samaḥ sāmanta.āyatta.kāryaḥ kartavya.balo vā bala.samād viśiṣṭena lābhena paṇeta

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले पर अनुग्रह करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।

words.gloss: [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point
than the one to be marched against

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √labh; m. nom. sg.

hindi: व्यसन उत्पन्न हुए, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाले पर आघात करने की इच्छा वाला; या सुआरम्भ किए हुए अथवा एक-अन्त सिद्धि वाले, इसके कर्म को नष्ट करने की इच्छा वाला; मूल पर या यात्रा में प्रहार करने की इच्छा वाला; या जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, उससे अधिक पाता हुआ, श्रेष्ठ, हीन या समान से अधिक माँगे।
english: Desiring to strike down [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point; desiring to destroy his action, well begun or of success at one end; desiring to strike at the base or on the march; or obtaining more than from the one to be marched against — [he] should ask more of a superior, an inferior or an equal.

text_flags.why: possible typo: stray compound dot; ablative of comparison 'more than from the yātavya' is two words

notes: Subject not stated. 'eka-anta-siddhim' may qualify karma or stand as a noun ('success at one end'). 'bhūyaḥ' = more (or 'again'). 'yātrā' = march (9.1). The last clause has the verb yāceta; whether the earlier desires are conditions or alternatives is not certain.
lines_deva: जात.व्यसन.प्रकृति.रन्ध्रम् अभिहन्तु.कामः स्व्.आरब्धम् एक.अन्त.सिद्धिं वा-अस्य कर्म.उपहन्तु.कामो मूले यात्रायां वा प्रहर्तु.कामो यातव्याद्.भूयो लभमानो वा ज्यायांसं हीनं समं वा भूयो याचेत
lines_iast: jāta.vyasana.prakṛti.randhram abhihantu.kāmaḥ sv.ārabdham eka.anta.siddhiṃ vā-asya karma.upahantu.kāmo mūle yātrāyāṃ vā prahartu.kāmo yātavyād.bhūyo labhamāno vā jyāyāṃsaṃ hīnaṃ samaṃ vā bhūyo yāceta

words.gloss: for the protection of his own army

hindi: या अधिक माँगा गया, अपनी सेना की रक्षा के लिए दूसरे की सेना के द्वारा दुर्धर्ष दूसरे का दुर्ग, आसार या वन कुचलने की इच्छा वाला, या लम्बे मार्ग अथवा काल में दूसरे की सेना को क्षय और व्यय से जोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, या दूसरे की सेना के द्वारा बढ़ा हुआ उसी को उखाड़ने की इच्छा वाला, या दूसरे की सेना को लेने की इच्छा वाला, अधिक दे।
english: Or, being asked for more, [he] should give more — desiring, for the protection of his own army, to crush with the other's army an unassailable fort of another, a reinforcer or a forest; or desiring to connect the other's army with loss and expenditure on a long road or in a long time; or, grown through the other's army, desiring to uproot that very one; or desiring to take the other's army.
notes: 'bhūyaḥ' = more (or 'again'). 'durdharṣam' may qualify only anya-durgam or all three objects. āsāra here 'reinforcer' (6.2), 'reinforcements' (10.4) possible. 'prakṛṣṭe' agrees with both adhvani and kāle ('long road or long time'). 'para-daṇḍa' = the other's army (para = the other). 'tam' = the one whose army has made him grow (not named). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: भूयो वा याचितः स्व.बल.रक्षा.अर्थं दुर्धर्षम् अन्य.दुर्गम् आसारम् अटवीं वा पर.दण्डेन मर्दितु.कामः प्रकृष्टे ऽध्वनि काले वा पर.दण्डं क्षय.व्ययाभ्यां योक्तु.कामः पर.दण्डेन वा विवृद्धस् तम् एव-उच्छेत्तु.कामः पर.दण्डम् आदातु.कामो वा भूयो दद्यात्
lines_iast: bhūyo vā yācitaḥ sva.bala.rakṣā.arthaṃ durdharṣam anya.durgam āsāram aṭavīṃ vā para.daṇḍena marditu.kāmaḥ prakṛṣṭe 'dhvani kāle vā para.daṇḍaṃ kṣaya.vyayābhyāṃ yoktu.kāmaḥ para.daṇḍena vā vivṛddhas tam eva-ucchettu.kāmaḥ para.daṇḍam ādātu.kāmo vā bhūyo dadyāt

words.gloss: on the pretext of the one to be marched against

hindi: या श्रेष्ठ, हीन को जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है, उसके बहाने हाथ में करने की इच्छा वाला; या दूसरे को उखाड़कर उसी को उखाड़ने की इच्छा वाला; या त्याग करके वापस लेने की इच्छा वाला, सेना के बराबर से विशिष्ट लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or a superior, desiring to bring the inferior into [his] hand on the pretext of the one to be marched against; or, having uprooted the other, desiring to uproot that very one; or, having made a relinquishment, desiring to take [it] back — should strike a bargain with a gain better than [one] equal to the army.
notes: haste kartu = literally 'to put in the hand' (bring under control). apadeśa = pretext (literally 'pointing out'). 'param' = the other (not 'enemy'); 'tam' = that very one (not named). tyāga = relinquishment (giving up); the object of pratyādātu is not stated ('[it]' bracketed). The party bargained with is not named.
lines_deva: ज्यायान् वा हीनं यातव्य.अपदेशेन हस्ते कर्तु.कामः परम् उच्छिद्य वा तम् एव-उच्छेत्तु.कामः, त्यागं वा कृत्वा प्रत्यादातु.कामो बल.समाद् विशिष्टेन लाभेन पणेत
lines_iast: jyāyān vā hīnaṃ yātavya.apadeśena haste kartu.kāmaḥ param ucchidya vā tam eva-ucchettu.kāmaḥ, tyāgaṃ vā kṛtvā pratyādātu.kāmo bala.samād viśiṣṭena lābhena paṇeta

army of the treasonable, enemies and forest tribes

notes: Subject not stated. daṇḍa = army. aṭavī here = forest tribes (force sense). The compound could also be read 'treasonable, enemy and forest troops'. 'Stay' (tiṣṭhet) is literal.

hindi: आरम्भ में सौदा किया हुआ और सौदा करने वाला कारण को जानें; तब दोनों ओर विचार करके जिस ओर श्रेष्ठ है, उस ओर जाए।
english: At first the one bargained with and the one bargaining should discern the cause; then, having reflected on both sides, [he] should go to the side on which [there is] the better.

text_flags.why: possible typo: '.' marks compound members, but vitarkya (absolutive) and ubhayataḥ are separate words; elsewhere the e-text joins such words with '-'

notes: budhyeta is singular with two subjects (agrees with the nearer). 'yataḥ ... tataḥ' read as 'on which side ... to that side'. 'ubhayataḥ' could also be 'from both sides'. Metre: two regular anuṣṭubh lines (8+8).
